optimizer.actual_implementation: SMART_GAIL.configure_optimizers -> AdamW; constructor defaults captured in actual checkpoint groups
optimizer.source_schedule: automatic supervised LambdaLR overwrites current_step with self.current_epoch+1, warmup0, cosine over128 epochs, floor ratio.05; scheduler is epoch based in returned list, not SD warmup500/constant step schedule.
optimizer.last_optimizer_vs_scheduler_caveat: Exact last-update LR versus saved scheduler LR at full epoch boundary depends on Lightning event ordering; no actual128epoch checkpoint was inspected. Observed checkpoint epoch10/LR is exact.
optimizer.batch_interpretation: Same LR per epoch but B256 has twice as many AdamW/EMA updates at the same scene exposure. Moment time scales and decoupled decay per example therefore differ; not an isolated EMA intervention.
